name: bare-stow
description: Module bundling and harness generation for Bare

exports.name: stow
signatures: stow(entry: URL | string, target: Target | TargetName, out: URL | string, opts?: StowOptions): AsyncGenerator<StowArtifact>
exports.description: Bundle the module graph rooted at `entry` for `target`, writing a harness plus bundle to `out`.

params.name: entry
params.description: - The entry module to bundle, as a `file:` URL or path string.

params.name: target
params.description: - The bundling target: a `Target` object, or a target name resolved to one (the built-in `bare-sidecar` and `bare-worker`, or a `bare-stow-target-<name>` package).

params.name: out
params.description: - The path to write the harness to, as a `file:` URL or path string; the bundle is written alongside it.

returns.description: An async generator that yields each written artifact's `url` as it is produced — the harness first, then the bundle, then any offloaded addon or asset files.

throws.condition: A host in `opts.hosts` is not supported by the resolved target.

exports.name: Target
signatures:
interface Target {
  name: string
  linked: boolean
  offload: boolean | { addons?: boolean; assets?: boolean }
  format: 'bundle' | 'bundle.cjs' | 'bundle.mjs' | 'bundle.json'
  encoding: string | null
  extension: string
  module?: 'esm' | 'cjs'
  hosts: string[]
  generate(context: TargetContext): Artifact[]
}
exports.description: A bundling target, such as `bare-sidecar` or `bare-worker`, describing how to package and boot a bundle on a given host runtime.

members.name: encoding
members.description: The text encoding used when the bundle format wraps the bundle as a string, or `null` when the bundle is written as raw bytes.

members.name: extension
members.description: The file extension used for the target's harness artifact.

members.name: format
members.description: The encoding format of the written bundle artifact.

members.name: generate
members.description: Generate the harness artifacts for `context`.

params.name: context
params.description: - The target context describing the bundle to embed and the RPC wiring to splice in.

members.name: hosts
members.description: The host triples the target supports.

members.name: linked
members.description: Whether the bundle links against its dependencies rather than inlining them.

members.name: module
members.description: The module system the harness is generated in, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`. When unset, it follows the output path's extension or nearest `package.json` `type`.

members.name: name
members.description: The target's name.

members.name: offload
signatures: offload: boolean | { addons?: boolean; assets?: boolean }
members.description: Whether native addons and/or assets are written out as sibling files instead of being inlined into the bundle.

exports.name: TargetContext
signatures:
interface TargetContext {
  bundleSpecifier: string
  ipc: string
  rpc: string
  module: 'esm' | 'cjs'
  client: RPCClient | null
}
exports.description: The context passed to a target's `generate()`, describing the bundle to embed and the RPC wiring to splice in.

members.name: bundleSpecifier
members.description: The module specifier the harness uses to load the bundle, relative to the harness itself.

members.name: client
members.description: The resolved client RPC wiring to splice into the harness, or `null` when no client RPC was requested.

members.name: ipc
members.description: The identifier bound to the IPC stream in generated harness code.

members.name: module
members.description: The module system the harness is generated in, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`.

members.name: rpc
members.description: The identifier bound to the RPC client/server in generated harness code.

exports.name: RPC
exports.description: An RPC library adapter that generates the wiring code spliced into a stowed bundle's harness or entry shim.

members.name: generate
members.description: Generate the RPC wiring artifacts for `context`.

params.name: context
params.description: - The RPC context describing the identifiers, module system, and role to generate wiring for.

members.name: name
members.description: The RPC adapter's name.

exports.name: RPCContext
exports.description: The context passed to an RPC adapter's `generate()`.

members.name: ipc
members.description: The identifier bound to the IPC stream in generated code.

members.name: module
members.description: The module system the generated code targets, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`.

members.name: role
members.description: Whether the generated wiring is for the `'client'` (harness side) or `'server'` (bundle entry shim side).

members.name: rpc
members.description: The identifier bound to the RPC client/server in generated code.

exports.name: RPCClient
exports.description: The resolved client RPC wiring, carrying both the runtime source to splice into the harness and the type declaration to splice into the harness's `.d.ts`.

members.name: source
members.description: The generated runtime source for the client RPC wiring.

members.name: type
members.description: The generated type declaration for the client RPC wiring.

exports.name: Artifact
exports.description: A single generated source artifact, such as a harness or a type declaration.

members.name: extension
members.description: The file extension the artifact should be written with alongside the primary output, or unset to write it to the primary output path itself.

members.name: source
members.description: The artifact's source text.

exports.name: StowOptions
signatures:
interface StowOptions {
  client?: RPC | RPCName
  server?: RPC | RPCName
  resolveTarget?(name: string): Target
  resolveRPC?(name: string): RPC
  concurrency?: number
  base?: URL | string
  defaultType?: number
  builtinProtocol?: string
  builtins?: Builtins
  conditions?: Conditions
  extensions?: string[]
  host?: string
  hosts?: string[]
  linkedProtocol?: string
  matchedConditions?: string[]
  resolutions?: ResolutionsMap
}

members.name: client
members.description: The RPC library (or its name) to wire into the harness.

members.name: resolveRPC
members.description: Resolve an RPC name to an `RPC`, overriding the default RPC resolution.

params.name: name
params.description: - The RPC name to resolve to an `RPC`.

members.name: resolveTarget
members.description: Resolve a target name to a `Target`, overriding the default target resolution.

params.name: name
params.description: - The target name to resolve to a `Target`.

members.name: server
members.description: The RPC library (or its name) to wire into the bundle's entry shim.

exports.name: StowArtifact
exports.description: An artifact written by `stow()`, yielded once its file has been written.

members.name: url
members.description: The file URL the artifact was written to.

exports.name: Protocol
signatures:
interface Protocol<E extends ProtocolEvents = ProtocolEvents> {
  send(type: string, payload?: object): Promise<void>
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  write(data: unknown, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: StreamCallback): boolean
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
}

members.name: Protocol
members.description: Attach a `Protocol` to the given underlying duplex byte `stream`.

params.name: stream
params.description: - The underlying duplex byte stream to multiplex the control and user-data channels over.

members.name: send
members.description: Send a control frame of `type` with an optional JSON-serializable `payload`.

params.name: type
params.description: - The control frame type, for example `'ready'`, `'exit'`, `'error'`, or `'terminate'`.

params.name: payload
params.description: - An optional JSON-serializable payload carried with the frame.

exports.name: ProtocolEvents
signatures:
interface ProtocolEvents {
  ready: []
  terminate: []
  exit: [code: number]
  data: [data: unknown]
  end: []
  readable: []
  piping: [dest: Writable]
  close: []
  error: [err: Error]
  drain: []
  finish: []
  pipe: [src: Readable]
}
exports.description: The events emitted by a `Protocol`, in addition to the standard duplex stream events.

members.name: exit
members.description: Emitted when the worker signals exit, carrying its exit `code`.

members.name: ready
members.description: Emitted when the worker signals it is ready.

members.name: terminate
members.description: Emitted when a `terminate` control frame is received.

exports.name: attach
exports.description: Attach a `Protocol` to `stream`, an underlying duplex byte stream.

params.name: stream
params.description: - Any duplex byte stream to attach the protocol to.

returns.description: A `Protocol` multiplexing control and user-data frames over `stream`.

exports.name: CONTROL
exports.description: The frame type marker identifying a control-channel frame.

exports.name: USER
exports.description: The frame type marker identifying a user-data-channel frame.

exports.name: wrap
exports.description: Wrap the host side of a stowed bundle's transport `stream`, returning an `IPC` handle with lifecycle helpers layered on top of the `Protocol`.

params.name: stream
params.description: - The host side of a stowed bundle's transport (any duplex byte stream).

returns.description: An `IPC` handle wrapping `stream`, with the `ready` promise and `terminate()` layered on top of `Protocol`.

exports.name: IPC
signatures:
interface IPC {

  terminate(): Promise<number | undefined>
  send(type: string, payload?: object): Promise<void>
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  write(data: unknown, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: StreamCallback): boolean
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
}

members.name: IPC
members.description: Wrap the host side of a stowed bundle's transport `stream`.

params.name: stream
params.description: - The host side of a stowed bundle's transport (any duplex byte stream).

members.name: ready
members.description: A promise that resolves once the worker has signaled ready, and rejects if the worker errors before then.

members.name: terminate
members.description: Send a `terminate` control frame to the worker and resolve with its exit code once it exits.

returns.description: The worker's exit `code` once it exits.
